open_points.other_text: - enter_viewer_access: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST set the session expires_at to created_at plus the viewer session lifetime, the imported VIEWER_SESSION_TTL_DAYS constant in days, and MUST NOT invent a lifetime or leave expires_at equal to created_at; an expiry that is not strictly later than created_at rejects the client on the next request. created_at and expires_at MUST both come from the one timestamp captured for this entry, so the lifetime is exactly the configured span.
open_points.question: Must VIEWER_SESSION_TTL_DAYS be specified or guaranteed to be greater than zero, or should the requirement stop demanding an expiry strictly later than created_at?
